text: Because the transmitter, after having transmitted the packet, will stop and wait for the acknowledgment from the receiver. If it receives the acknowledgment, fine, we can proceed with a new packet transmission. Instead, if the packet transmission fails, the transmitter will repeat the transmission. Okay, this process of repeating the transmission, as we said, goes on till a maximum number of times. Okay, we do not continue to infinity, we stop at a certain point, and if the transmitter cannot transmit the packet successfully after a maximum number of attempts, it just discards the packet. Okay, now, as we said, this kind of techniques are called ARQ, right? Automatic retransmission request, and now we understand also why they are called automatic retransmission request. Because the receiver, by not sending.
